summary: doom_platform_hosttest.c with four faults in private copies of Doom's control paths in ports/doom/doomgeneric_rach2.c and ports/doom/src/i_system.c; the test includes them by paths relative to itself, so the build copies the test and ports/doom under the work directory

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/ports ${WORK}/b/tests/host; cp -R ports/doom ${WORK}/b/ports/doom; cp ${SRC}/ports/doom/doomgeneric_rach2.c ${WORK}/b/ports/doom/doomgeneric_rach2.c; cp ${SRC}/ports/doom/src/i_system.c ${WORK}/b/ports/doom/src/i_system.c; cp tests/host/doom_platform_hosttest.c ${WORK}/b/tests/host/; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat -I ${WORK}/b/ports/doom/src -DNORMALUNIX -DCMAP256 ${WORK}/b/tests/host/doom_platform_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/doom_platform_hosttest

faults.name: shutdown
faults.summary: an exit that leaves the devices open

faults.name: report
faults.summary: a report that names the zone asked for, not the one allocated
